news.title: Tech stocks lead ASX higher after Wall Street surge; oil snaps losing run
news.snippet: The Australian sharemarket advanced on Tuesday, led by tech stocks after an AI-fuelled rally on Wall Street, even as oil prices ended their four-day drop during the session.

news.title: Platina banks final $2M Rio cheque for WA gold push
news.snippet: Platina Resources has banked the final US$2m from its Owendale scandium sale to Rio Tinto, completing a US$14m payday to add more financial firepower to its expanding WA gold hunt.

news.title: Dalaroo cranks up Côte d’Ivoire gold quest as assays loom
news.snippet: Dalaroo Metals has cranked up its Côte d’Ivoire gold drilling to two shifts, with first samples from its 7km Gold Ridge corridor now in the laboratory as assays loom.

news.title: Advance nails 4120g/t silver stunner in Mexico
news.snippet: Advance Metals has drilled a bonanza 1m hit of 4120g/t silver at its Gavilanes project in Mexico, associated with the project’s highest-grade zinc-lead mineralisation to date.

Jetstar staff to stop charging baggage and seat fees in union protest
news.snippet: Weeks after Jetstar unveiled a new overhead baggage fee, the Australian Services Union said its members will waive a range of fees as they push for higher pay.

news.title: Have the Murdochs lost faith in Donald Trump?
news.snippet: Donald Trump owes his dominance of American politics to Rupert Murdoch’s Fox News. But this week, the media empire deserted the president.

news.title: Pain at the pump: Saudi oil shock sends Australian fuel prices surging
news.snippet: Petrol and diesel prices have returned to their highest levels in nearly six months and risk climbing further after attacks on another key oil route.
